name: Truc Lam Dao Nguyen
nameVi: Thiền viện Trúc Lâm Đạo Nguyên
summary: Walk the pine-forest monastery at Nam Nung, about 39 or 40 km north of Gia Nghia. The grounds hold the main hall, a bell tower, a drum tower, and a stone garden of the Buddha's verses. Entry is free. Hours are Check on arrival, so come in the morning and keep the halls quiet.
getThere: About 39 or 40 km north of Gia Nghia, on TL 686.
heroCaption: The main hall, with stone lions on the stair
body: Walk the grounds in the pines beside Nam Nung Nature Reserve, in Nâm N'Jang, Dak Song. It is the largest Truc Lam monastery in Dak Nong, and the only one of that school here. You pass the main hall, the monks' quarters, the bell tower, the drum tower, the Quan The Am hall, the dining hall, and the guest house. A stone garden carries verses carved into the rock of the plateau.

Entry is free. How long you stay, and when the halls open, are Check on arrival. From Gia Nghia the road is about 39 km and about 40 km. The minutes are Check on arrival. The monastery backs onto the Nam Nung range at 1,500 m, and the air stays cool through the year. Come in the morning, and keep the halls quiet.

gettingThere: The monastery is on TL 686 in Nâm N'Jang, Dak Song, beside Nam Nung Nature Reserve. From Gia Nghia the road runs north for about 39 km and about 40 km. Hire a car or a motorbike. The minutes are Check on arrival.
